lane_assignment: H86P-PFA (Rank 1 below, frozen in research/H86P_PFA_PREREGISTRATION.md before any feature/model implementation)
scope_note: Five exact methods checked by code/registry search in this checkout on 2026-10-26 (grep over src/, scripts/, research/, registry/). Not a claim of global novelty. No numeric leaderboard projection is made; expected gain is qualitative. A projection is never a score.
ranking_basis: Qualitative expected HOLDOUT-DTI information gain per implementation cost, weighted by (a) specificity to catalogue-missing (sediment-blanketed / blind) faults, (b) distance from executed lanes, (c) sandbox obtainability. Evidence classes: proposal text only; no HOLDOUT-DTI measured for ranks 2-5 in this session.

hypotheses.name: Paired-flank multi-physics cross-strike asymmetry (step, not ridge) at 400/700 m offsets

layers.name: tc
layers.verified_physics: GeoDAWN airborne radiometric Total Count (src/gems86/io.py BAND_PHYSICS_VERIFIED, r=+0.997 vs geodawn_rad_u8 TC)

hypotheses.physical_signature: For each field smoothed at sigma=1.5 px and each of 4 cross-strike axes and offsets d in {4,7} px: flank contrast A=(f(+d*n)-f(-d*n))/(local dispersion at sigma=5 px). Step purity P=|f(+)-f(-)|/(|f(+)-f(-)|+|f(0)-(f(+)+f(-))/2|+eps) rewards a centre lying midway between two different flanks (a step/contact) and penalises a centre extreme against two similar flanks (a dike/ridge/hogback). Per-field feature=max_{axis,d} |A|*P; plus multi-physics concordance (fields agreeing on best axis with |A| above a frozen cut), pfa_max and pfa_second. No raw regional levels are used.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A piedmont fault buried under its own alluvium has no scarp for the USGS/INGENIOUS trace catalogue, but the hanging-wall side is systematically thicker sediment: Total Count is diluted, near-surface conductivity rises (clay/saline fill), basement deepens and gravity falls across the same buried trace. That is a signed, multi-physics flank step with no surface break.
hypotheses.novelty: No executed lane computes explicit +/-400-700 m paired-flank medians/contrasts with a centre-intermediate step-purity factor. H86O-2_TCW (registry/h86o_hypotheses_20261025.json, NOT_RUN) proposed a single-field TC asymmetry along elevation breaks; H86P-PFA generalises it to 5 fields, 4 axes x 2 offsets, dispersion normalisation, concordance and a step-vs-ridge purity veto, inside a fold-safe supervised LOQO stack with a same-allocator ablation. SLCQ's Log-Cauchy odd/even quadrature is a pointwise wavelet phase test, not flank sampling; EWCS/SLCQ/MCSP gradient magnitudes are sign- and side-blind.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Alluvial fan-toe progradation fronts, Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline benches bordering conductive playas, buried paleochannel/fanglomerate facies changes, and lithologic contacts (e.g. Miocene basaltic-andesite flow margins) all produce one-sided TC/conductivity/depth steps with no fault displacement.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Highest qualitative priority in this queue: it adds side/sign information that gradient magnitude cannot represent, on fields that respond to sediment thickness rather than scarp expression, so it can in principle lift both the catalogue-hide instrument and the blind arm. No numeric gain is claimed before measurement.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-medium; native bands only, deterministic shifts/filters, reuses EWCS fold-visible elastic fields, SLCQ quadrant calibration, STDP Dinkelbach-CELF allocator, shared evaluate_holdout and submission_writer.
hypotheses.falsifier: E1 (baseline+PFA) fails to beat E3 (identical baseline, identical allocator, no PFA) with a strictly positive paired 95% CI on gems57-pooled-hide-v2, or any single-feature canary discriminative AUC > 0.90, or the surface/final dots fire the registry rho>0.90 / informative dot-overlap>0.70 stops.

hypotheses.name: Seismicity-conditioned dilatancy hard conjunction (unsupervised gate)
hypotheses.physical_signature: Rank-normalised dilatation rate hard-gated to cells with recorded event density (B16>0 or B10>0); unsupervised emission, no fitted model (inherited verbatim from registry/h86o_hypotheses_20261025.json rank 4, still NOT_RUN).
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Seismogenic blind faults under basin fill can host microseismicity and present-day dilatational strain with no mapped scarp.
hypotheses.novelty: Prior lanes use seismicity only as an additive supervised feature; H86N-EQL (executed, negative) used earthquake-lineation tensor anisotropy. A pure unsupervised conjunction gate remains unrun, but EQL's negative lowers its prior.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Geothermal production/injection-induced seismicity, volcanic swarms, quarry blasts.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Moderate-low; cheap and specific but event density is sparse at 100 m, so coverage of withheld pixels is doubtful.
hypotheses.falsifier: Fails to beat dilatation-only and seismicity-only controls with positive paired CI, or canary AUC > 0.90.

hypotheses.name: Basement-depth slope-break kink signed by gravity residual
hypotheses.physical_signature: Cross-strike second-derivative kink of B15 at sigma 2-4 px multiplied by sign concordance of the B13 local residual (deep side must be gravity-low). B15 is gravity-derived, so concordance is a consistency filter, not independent corroboration (inherited from h86o rank 6, still NOT_RUN as this exact signed kink).
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A buried half-graben hinge displaces the basement surface without a ground-surface scarp.
hypotheses.novelty: Weakest novelty in this queue: EWCS already uses base hinge curvature and SLCQ an intrabasin keystone hinge; only the gravity-sign gating of the depth kink is unrun. Circularity with B13 must be tested against the unsigned kink.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Buried paleovalley walls, caldera ring margins, inversion smoothing in the gravity-derived depth surface.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low-moderate; sound buried-hinge logic, limited by B15 resolution and B13 circularity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Signed kink fails to beat |grad depth| and unsigned-kink controls with positive paired CI.

hypotheses.name: Directional topographic openness anisotropy (positive-minus-negative openness director) from the pinned 10 m DEM derivative grid
hypotheses.physical_signature: Azimuthal (8-direction) positive/negative openness difference reduced to a spin-2 director; fault scarps and aligned faceted spurs produce a coherent one-sided openness polarity along strike that isotropic slope/curvature cannot encode.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Degraded scarps in alluvium may fall below the catalogue's mapping confidence while retaining a coherent facing polarity at 10 m.
hypotheses.novelty: Repo lanes use DEM Hessian/curvature, LiDAR scarp steps and chi knickzones, but no directional openness (sky-view) anisotropy director was found by search. Band semantics of the pinned topo10 grid must be re-verified before any use; that audit cost is why this is rank 4 not rank 2.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Pluvial shoreline treads, hogback dip slopes, alluvial-fan channel levees, road/rail grades.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Moderate if band semantics verify; otherwise not viable. No measurement made.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; external grid already pinned locally, but semantics + fold-safe orientation handling need a frozen audit first.
hypotheses.falsifier: Band-semantics audit cannot verify openness channels, or the director fails to beat DEM-Hessian controls with positive paired CI.
hypotheses.external_data_source: USGS 3DEP (free, official): https://www.usgs.gov/3d-elevation-program - the derived 100 m grid is already SHA-pinned in this repo (.cache/external/topo_10m_derived_100m_u8.tif), so no sandbox download is needed.

hypotheses.name: NASA OPERA Sentinel-1 LOS creep step x USGS ASTER SWIR hydrothermal alteration

layers.external: ASTER SWIR Al-OH/opaline alteration (USGS, DOI 10.5066/P9BA3684 as cited in prior preregistrations)

hypotheses.physical_signature: Persistent LOS displacement discontinuity (aseismic creep / subsiding hanging wall) co-located with Al-OH/opaline silica alteration along a concealed upflow fault.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Actively creeping, hydrothermally altered blind faults can lack any mapped trace while deforming and altering the surface.
hypotheses.novelty: No lane in this fleet uses InSAR displacement or SWIR mineralogy; scientifically the most independent evidence class in this queue.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Groundwater/geothermal-production subsidence bowls, landslide creep, playa clay shrink-swell, mining deformation.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Unknown and NOT VALIDATABLE in this sandbox: data hosts are outside the 6-host egress allowlist (github.com, codeload.github.com, api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org), so the idea is explicitly deferred, not proposed as viable here. On an unrestricted workstation the sources are free and official.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High (deferred); time-series InSAR + mineral mapping + co-registration to EPSG:32611 100 m grid.
hypotheses.falsifier: Not run. Would require the creep-step x alteration conjunction to beat either layer alone with positive paired CI.
hypotheses.external_data_source: NASA ASF DAAC OPERA (free, official): https://asf.alaska.edu/datasets/daac/opera/ and USGS ASTER alteration (free, official): https://doi.org/10.5066/P9BA3684 - both checked 2026-10-25/26 as official free sources, but unobtainable from this sandbox's egress allowlist.
